cohort: 86 newborns from multiple pregnancies admitted to the Special Care Neonatal Unit (SCANU) of Mymensingh Medical College Hospital (MMCH), Bangladesh, from January 2015 to March 2015
finding: Multiple pregnancies were associated with a high incidence of preterm birth, low birth weight, neonatal morbidity (jaundice, RDS, perinatal asphyxia, sepsis, congenital anomalies), and mortality.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery for the multiple pregnancies was not specified in relation to the outcomes.
